creator_name.description: Display name of the submitting Assignar user (free text, not a resolved identity).

external_id.description: Stable identity of the source incident record (Assignar form-result id, cast to text).

financial_period.description: The period the incident falls in, derived from `occurred_at`; the axis retention is computed against.

form_id.description: The source form template the incident was captured on.

form_title.description: The source form template's title, i.e. which tenant incident template this is.

jurisdiction.description: The WHS regime whose notification and retention rules apply to this record.

modified_time.description: Source last-modified time; the delta-harvest cursor.

narrative.description: The incident description, composed from the source responses Q&A; may be null when nothing is renderable.

occurred_at.description: When the incident happened/was submitted; the notification and recording clock.

outcome_class.description: Worst recorded outcome: none / first aid / medical treatment / restricted work / days away / death.

worker.description: Worker involved or submitting; resolves to the worker spine.
